collection: All available PDFs under curriculum/asphalt-paving, excluding this context directory

chunk_policy.single_page_over_target_policy: Preserve the page without image degradation; flag an exception. A chunk at or above 100,000,000 bytes fails the build.

processing: Original PDF page appearance retained without image downsampling. MS-4, CAT, readiness and study-series source parts are referenced directly without duplicate PDF copies. MS-4 text comes from the upstream OCR pipeline; CAT, readiness and other texts use pdftotext. Internal/non-URI annotations are omitted from split chunks; reused native source parts retain valid in-part links, and MS-4 image-only parts have no such links.
